title: Angry Skeleton
description: This texture pack makes the skeleton angry because its done of its job
body:
# Angry Skeletons

Turns every skeleton angery.

This texture pack changes the default skeleton textures to look much angrier, with aggressive expressions and a more intimidating appearance while keeping the classic Minecraft style.

## Compatibility

* Minecraft Java Edition
* Works with most resource-pack-friendly mods and shaders
* Recommended resolution: 16x16

## Installation

1. Download the pack
2. Open Minecraft
3. Go to **Options → Resource Packs**
4. Click **Open Pack Folder**
5. Move the `.zip` file into the folder
6. Enable the pack in-game
